posts.title_en: So what do I do in conquest now?
posts.summary_en: F2P asks for the ATK order and whether to swap Cherry for Melon Soda (yes). Reply: same as before, but Milk and Chardonnay take fixed straws, so steer the rest to Cheesecake, Skating Queen and Tea Knight; Brightseeker also gets one, almost fixed by TSSR power. Pre-patch, with Pomegranate on Tiger Lily's volley synergy, the straws went Brightseeker, Milk, Macaron, Cheesecake, Skating Queen, Tea Knight; now Chardonnay takes Macaron's place.
